pkgmetadata.longdescription: The library bundle of the Terser JavaScript minifier (dist/bundle.min.js in the npm package), built from source, including @jridgewell/source-map built from its TypeScript. Installed per Terser version as /usr/lib/terser/VERSION/terser.js. Used by www-client/chromium instead of the prebuilt bundle in the terser npm package it bundles.
